title: Innokin EZ.Watt Vape Kit
description: The Innokin EZ.WATT is a sleek and stylish Vape Starter Kit that should appeal to both newer vapers and more experienced vapers alike. Designed with convenience and simplicity in mind, this remarkable vape kit delivers an effortless MTL (Mouth To Lung) vaping experience that requires minimal maintenance. The built-in 1500mAh battery effortlessly powers your vaping journey over long vaping sessions. With three power levels (Full, Half and Low) at your fingertips, the kit gives you full control over your vape. The Innokin EZ.WATT kit is incredibly versatile, allowing you to adapt to different vaping styles. Easily adjust the power output with a simple button click, and the LED indicator shows your current level. Despite its large built-in battery, the EZ.WATT remains lightweight and compact, making it ideal for vaping on the go. Plus, the kit can be locked to prevent accidental activations when it's in your pocket or bag. The Innokin Prism T20-S tank included in this kit is reliable and straightforward and effortlessly matches the mod’s style. With its 2ml e-liquid capacity, you can enjoy your favourite flavours. Refilling is a breeze thanks to the removable top section, saving you time and effort. For a cigarette-like, MTL (mouth-to-lung) sensation, we recommend using the 1.5 Ohm Prism S coil with a 50/50, Nic Salt or High PG E-liquid . If you prefer slightly more vapour production, go for the 0.8 Ohm coil with a 50/50 e-liquid. Experience the convenience and stunning performance of the Innokin EZ.WATT Vape Starter Kit. It's the perfect choice for both beginners and experienced vapers alike. Check out our premium vape juice blends and pair them seamlessly with your kit. Please Note: Innokin T20-S Coils are compatible with this kit. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
